scope: generic Legacy chat clarification — resolver-driven, never Pi shadow output, never hardcoded companies

clarification.prompt: 请确认你指的是哪家公司：

candidate_rules.trigger: normal resolution failed AND a short Chinese alias matches 2..8 distinct short names in the resolver index
candidate_rules.dedup: market+symbol, then cross-market duplicate names keep the highest-priority market (CN>HK>US)
candidate_rules.ordering: prefix match -> short_name length -> market priority -> symbol (fully deterministic)

transport.sse: single agent_completed terminal event carries response_kind/clarification (old clients ignore)
transport.persistence: chat_messages.msg_metadata JSONB via existing compaction whitelist — no migration
transport.session_detail: ChatMessageItem.metadata sanitized subset restores candidates after refresh
